Title: CX Data Scientist
Description: Farmacias del Ahorro es una compañía 100% mexicana, dedicada a proveer servicios de salud y bienestar a todos los mexicanos. Con una destacada trayectoria de más de 30 años en el mercado, hemos logrado un crecimiento firme y constante, brindando servicio a través de nuestras más de 1,800 sucursales y un gran equipo de trabajo mayor a 22,000 colaboradores. Descripción general : Transformar los datos de experiencia del cliente (VoC) e información transaccional en inteligencia financiera y predictiva. Su meta es cuantificar el impacto económico de las fallas de servicio, construir casos de negocio (costo-beneficio) y prevenir la deserción (churn), dictando a la operación exactamente dónde invertir esfuerzos para maximizar la rentabilidad y la lealtad. Funciones generales: Traducción financiera de CX: Programar en SQL y Python para cruzar datos de experiencia (NPS, CES, CSAT) con transacciones financieras, calculando el impacto real de las fallas en el negocio (caída de ingresos, ticket promedio, etc.). Priorización analítica de fricciones: Diagnosticar causas raíz de mala experiencia y construir casos de negocio utilizando matrices de costo-beneficio para definir qué correcciones operativas son viables y urgentes. Modelado y prevención de churn: Conectar los hallazgos de Voz del Cliente (VoC) con los modelos de segmentación interna (VACE) para identificar proactivamente clústeres de clientes en riesgo de deserción. Auditoría y exigencia operativa: Supervisar y auditar de manera empírica que las áreas operativas ejecuten las correcciones priorizadas, midiendo el impacto real en los indicadores tras la intervención. Ingeniería de datos VoC: Desarrollar, optimizar y mantener el código necesario para automatizar la limpieza, categorización y análisis de datos de clientes, garantizando la escalabilidad del sistema. Requerimientos y criterios de selección: Licenciatura / Ingeniería en Actuaría, Físico Matemático o afín. Experiencia 3+ años en análisis de información, evaluación financiera de proyectos (casos de negocio y cálculo de ROI), Modelado de clientes y segmentación de valor (VACE, RFM, propensión al churn). Dominio matemático de métricas CX (NPS, CES, CSAT). Herramientas: SQL avanzado, Python (Pandas, NumPy, análisis estadístico y minería de datos). Modelo de trabajo: Presencial En Farmacias del Ahorro, ¡Te queremos... Bien! Promovemos y verificamos la adopción de medidas a favor de la igualdad de oportunidades y la eliminación de toda forma de discriminación en cualquiera de nuestros procesos de selección y en nuestros centros de trabajo. Nunca te solicitaremos ningún tipo de pago como parte del proceso de reclutamiento, toma precauciones y evita caer en fraude.

Title: EE Quality (Data Mining) Engineer

In this role, you will leverage telematics data, vehicle diagnostic logs (DTCs), over-the-air (OTA) metrics, and warranty databases to mine, analyze, and translate complex vehicle system data into actionable quality improvements. You will bridge the gap between Big Data analytics and hardware/software systems engineering, detecting emerging quality trends early and collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve root-cause failures before they impact customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities 1. Data Mining & Field Quality Analytics Build, execute, and maintain automated data pipelines and queries to extract quality insights from vehicle telematics, Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), warranty claims, OTA software logs, and customer feedback. Apply statistical models, pattern recognition, and machine learning techniques to identify emerging E/E quality risks, software anomalies, and intermittent system behavior in production fleets. Establish predictive quality indicators (e.g., early-warning algorithms) to flag potential field issues before traditional warranty reporting triggers occur. 2. EE Systems Root Cause & Technical Analysis Partner with Systems Engineers, DREs, and Software Quality Engineers to correlate mined data with root-cause physical or software failure modes (e.g., CAN/LIN/Ethernet bus communication loss, voltage drops, ECU resets, sensors/actuators degradation). Analyze raw vehicle bus logs (CAN trace files, PCAP) alongside cloud telemetry to reconstruct system-level failure scenarios. Participate in root-cause investigations using structured frameworks (8D, 5 Whys, Ishikawa, Fishbone) to drive Permanent Corrective Actions (PCA). 3. Quality Metrics, Dashboards & Reporting Develop, automate, and manage interactive quality dashboards (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau) to visualize E/E system health, warranty trends (R/1000, CPU), and recall risks for executive leadership and engineering teams. Monitor software update (OTA) campaign success rates, post-flash error rates, and battery-drain telemetry. Present data-backed technical findings during program quality reviews, gate approvals, and supplier quality syncs. 4. Supplier & Cross-Functional Quality Collaboration Work with Tier-1 ECU/Software suppliers to reconcile field diagnostic data with component-level test results and manufacturing logs. Provide data evidence to validate software bug fixes, EE design revisions, and hardware modifications. Contribute to continuous improvement by updating DFMEA, PFMEA, and E/E quality standards based on insights gained from field data mining. Qualifications & Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience: 3+ years of experience in E/E quality engineering, vehicle systems diagnostics, or automotive data analytics. Data Mining & Analytics Skills: Proficient in SQL for database queries and data extraction. Strong programming capabilities in Python or R for data wrangling, statistical analysis, and script automation (using libraries like Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn). Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau). Automotive E/E Knowledge: Solid understanding of automotive E/E architectures, ECUs, sensors, actuators, and communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet, FlexRay). Familiarity with OBD-II diagnostics, UDS (ISO 14229), and Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) structures. Experience interpreting vehicle log files using tools like Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, Wireshark, or similar. Languages: Business fluency in English (written and spoken). Preferred Qualifications Experience working with OEM telematics platforms, cloud storage (AWS, Azure, GCP), or big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Databricks). Knowledge of ASPICE, ISO 26222 (Functional Safety), or ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity). Six Sigma Green/Black Belt certification. Key Competencies Analytical Curiosity: Driven to dig deep into unstructured data to uncover hidden system bugs and trends. Translational Communication: Ability to articulate complex data insights into clear engineering and business terms for non-data science stakeholders. System-Level Mindset: Capable of viewing failures holistically—connecting hardware, embedded software, and network interactions. Title: Master Data Analyst
Description: JOB DESCRIPTION Material Master Analyst Position Summary The material master position focuses on analyzing new product information and maintenance requests, which involves mass templates loaded into SAP for all plants. Master data checks are executed and analyzed for errors and expert feedback is provided and addressed to all DRiV cross-functional users. Documentation of new requirements is critical to create success of accurate data, which is key to productivity. Master data support is required on key projects for system conversions globally. The position is responsible for executing master data checks, review and resolve data integrity issues. Errors missed can affect order-to-cash on a large scale for all DRiV customers. Responsibilities : Manage, analyze and update master data records for consolidation/deletion, and enhance master data content in SAP for DRiV Ability to run queries and assist in master data corrections; totals 130 queries. Analyze and process NPI and maintenance requests for all product lines; provide expert feedback to users. Standard cost ability on product as requested for all DRIV locations in North America Update training and template documentation for all business users (Supply Chain, product management, finance analysts, and engineering). Identify and troubleshoot errors along with training users on mass load templates. Develop, recommend and implement business process enhancements, as well as design and execute SAP queries as needed for data. Coordinates New Product Introduction (NPI) and ensures master data coding conventions are applied as it relates to proper configuration within SAP and by plant, by product line. Input data into the SAP system for new/existing products and make necessary changes to existing SAP data for current products. Provide guidance and recommendations to business units to enhance the quality of customer, material and master data. Participate in master data activities for vendor and product. Ensure that standards and guidelines are created for all aspects. Assist in process improvement initiatives by working across technical teams to enhance the systems, process and controls to ensure effective development. Coordination with SAP development team for data export/imports Knowledge of various SAP modules such as SAP FICO (Financial Accounting and Controlling), SAP MM (Materials Management), and SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) Strong skills in data analysis and reporting tools such as SAP BW (Business Warehouse) and SAP BO (BusinessObjects). Experience with SAP PI/PO (Process Integration/Process Orchestration) for integrating SAP with other systems. Knowledge of database management systems and SQL. Conduct training plans as required on projects. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience 3+ years of experience with reports and customer analysis experience, SAP Master Data or data maintenance Excellent verbal and written skills Must interface with management and field personnel, and external customers. Must be able to work in a team setting, as well as individually with minimal supervision. Excellent analytical skills required; must be able to quickly analyze SAP master data Expertise in Excel, Powerpoint, Access and Microsoft Excellent communication skills to engage with stakeholders and team members Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to manage projects, planning, execution, and monitor launches Capability to work efficiently independantly Flexibility to adapt to changing business environments and new technologies

Description: La plataforma de comercio digital líder en México. About the Role We are looking for a Product Manager, Data Product, to lead the strategy, roadmap, design, and continuous evolution of data products supporting Mi Clip Wallet. This role will translate business and operational needs into scalable, reliable, and actionable data solutions for Fintech use cases such as payments, acquiring, digital wallets, user growth, compliance, and operations. Own the full product lifecycle, from problem definition and requirements analysis through solution design, prototyping, development, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration. Partner with technical teams to translate product vision into PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, data requirements, dependencies, delivery plans, and quality controls. Ensure that data products meet applicable privacy, security, and regulatory requirements across operating markets by working closely with Legal, Compliance, and Security teams, while measuring product adoption, data quality, business impact, and opportunities for improvement. Data Analysis of product performance. Excel knowledge and Data Analysis; it means knowing how to make a case with data and SQL querying and understanding attribution problems are all essential.
